function.name: GET_COMPLAINT_STATE

userMobileNumber.description: The mobile number of the user, formatted as a string without spaces or special characters (e.g., '1234567890').

function.name: handover_to_agent
function.description: This function initiates a handover process to transfer the ongoing chat session from a virtual assistant to a human agent. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.description: An optional message from the virtual assistant to the human agent.
